findings.claim: The lint command has a documented `--skip-drift` path that lets generated-file drift pass, violating the requirement that lint fail on any installed definition drift.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria: “A drift check SHALL regenerate every harness definition and `AGENTS.md` from their sources and fail on any byte difference” and “A lint command SHALL fail when ... any installed definition differs from a fresh export of `.agent-team/team.json`.” The CLI implements `if (args.includes("--skip-drift")) console.log("lint-agents: WARNING drift check skipped (--skip-drift); CI still runs it"); else problems.push(...driftProblems(repoRoot));`, so `lint-agents --skip-drift` can exit 0 without checking byte drift.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the public skip path from `lint-agents`, or make skipped drift force a non-zero exit for the lint command; use a separate non-lint developer helper if offline operation is needed.
